title: Zoho Campaigns Update: MCP AI Agents + WhatsApp Marketing (Nov 2026)
headline: Zoho Campaigns now works with *AI agents*
source_line: Source: Zoho press release, 13 Nov 2026 (via Media OutReach / Malay Mail, allAfrica)

sources.name: Zoho press release (Malay Mail / Media OutReach, 13 Nov 2026)
allAfrica - Zoho simplifies multichannel marketing with AI agent capabilities

description:
Zoho has rebuilt Zoho Campaigns (announced 13 Nov 2026): native WhatsApp marketing, support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so compatible AI agents can run multi-step campaign tasks from plain-language instructions (you still review and approve), live Zoho CRM sync, and faster sending (up to 4x faster for 100,000 emails in Zoho's own tests). Paid plans still start at $4 a month; free plan up to 500 contacts and 2,000 emails a month. Available now in all regions.

Sources (checked 15 Nov 2026):
- Zoho press release via Malay Mail: https://malaymail.com/amp/news/money/mediaoutreach/2026/11/13/zoho-rebuilds-campaigns-platform-with-simpler-email-and-sms-native-whatsapp-and-ai-agent-workflows/500803
- allAfrica: https://allafrica.com/stories/202611120216.html
- https://www.zoho.com/campaigns

This video uses an AI-generated presenter, voice and animations; facts were checked against the sources above.

MCP: AI agents connect to Campaigns
The agent does the steps, you approve

lines: Zoho just rebuilt Zoho Campaigns, and AI agents can now do parts of your marketing work.
It now supports M C P, the open standard that lets compatible AI agents connect to the app.
Ask for a seasonal campaign or a re-engagement segment in plain language, and the agent does the steps. You still review and approve.

stats.label: paid plans from, per month - unchanged

lines: WhatsApp marketing is now built in, with bulk campaigns from approved templates, and triggered messages.
Zoho says sending a hundred thousand emails is now up to four times faster, in its own tests.
And pricing stays the same. Paid plans still start at four dollars a month, and the free plan covers up to five hundred contacts.
If you use Zoho CRM, contacts and segments now sync live into Campaigns. It's available now, in all regions.
